notes: Verified against Blackmagic's official techspecs page (a combined page covering all URSA Mini Pro variants: 12K, 12K OLPF, 4.6K G2) and cross-checked against the official URSA Mini/URSA Mini Pro user manual PDF (documents.blackmagicdesign.com/UserManuals/BlackmagicURSAMiniManual.pdf) for the physical connector legend and labels, since the techspecs page groups ports generically as "Total Video Inputs/Outputs". The standard URSA Mini Pro 12K and 12K OLPF variants share identical I/O (OLPF differs only by an internal optical low-pass filter); this record applies to both. Omitted from the port list as non-cable mount/accessory interfaces rather than discrete signal/power connectors: the rear Battery Mount Plate (a recessed 12-pin Molex connector under a V-mount/Gold-mount battery plate dock, regulated 12V up to 1.5A) and the 12-pin Broadcast Lens Control Connector (present only with PL/B4 lens mounts, powers/controls the lens rather than general AV gear). LANC input's physical jack is 2.5mm TRS; no 2.5mm option exists in the connector enum so it is mapped to the closest match, trs-3.5. Ships with a PL mount by default (EF, B4, F mounts available via the interchangeable lens mount system), which is not represented as a port. Desktop/handheld cinema camera, not rack-mountable.

ports.name: 12G-SDI Out
ports.note: Main program SDI output; switches between 1.5G/3G/6G/12G rates depending on format

ports.name: 12G-SDI In
ports.note: Used for switcher/recorder return feed, external reference, ATEM camera control/tally/talkback, and external timecode

ports.name: HD Monitoring Out
ports.note: Down-converted 1080HD monitoring output; used with URSA Viewfinder or external monitors

ports.name: Reference/Timecode In (REF In)
ports.note: Auto-detecting tri-level sync/black burst/timecode reference input

ports.name: +12V Power Input
ports.note: 4-pin 12-20V DC XLR input for the supplied power adapter or external/portable batteries

ports.name: +12V Power Output
ports.note: 4-pin XLR accessory power output (e.g. URSA Viewfinder); shares a 2A total budget with the lens connector

ports.name: LANC Input
ports.note: Physical jack is 2.5mm TRS (no 2.5mm option in connector list, mapped to closest trs-3.5); rec start/stop plus iris/focus on compatible EF lenses, or for the optional URSA Handgrip

ports.name: Headphone/Headset
ports.note: 3.5mm jack; headphone monitoring output, also accepts iPhone/Android headset mic input for talkback (embedded on SDI channels 15/16)

ports.name: USB-C (External Drive Recording)
ports.note: Locking USB-C 3.1 Gen 2 port for Blackmagic RAW recording direct to external flash disk/SSD

ports.name: USB-C (Software Update)
ports.note: USB-C port for Blackmagic Camera Setup software updates; generation/speed not stated in spec sheet

ports.name: XLR Audio In 1
ports.note: Balanced input switchable between mic/line/AES3 digital audio; 48V phantom power support

ports.name: XLR Audio In 2
ports.note: Balanced input switchable between mic/line/AES3 digital audio; 48V phantom power support
